leadText:
Len (Japanese: レン Ren) is a character of the day who appeared in Distant Blue Sky!.

Len was first seen swimming in a lake where he was chased by a . Len bumped into who was also swimming in the lake and was able to get out of the water. Len watched as Ash battled and attempted to catch the Gyarados, only for the Gyarados to flee.

After this, Len had a battle against Ash, using his to battle against , only to be defeated.
